newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FALL - GASOLINE DOWN AS SQUEEZE ENDS.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FALL - GASOLINE DOWN AS SQUEEZE ENDS.

text.p: NWE oil products were largely softer on Friday.
Gasoline prompt barges fell $13 as a market squeeze was seen ended and first half August Eurograde deals were seen done at $216 FOB ARA and $220 FOB Rotterdam.
Naphtha swaps fell $3-$4 on lower crude futures to $191-$192 for August and $186-$187 for September after a $187 September trade was heard publicly brokered.
Gas oil fell by $2.00 a tonne in more active trade. Dealers said the drop in prices encouraged more buying interest.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were little changed in a quiet market, traded at $94.50 for RMG material, with late bids and offers at $94.50/$95.50 for refinery product.
One cracked cargo was said offered $3 stronger at $88 fob while offers of Russian material were steady, with two means +$2 seen as the top of the range.
